g.text: RoleID, FK to Roles (1 Admin, 2 Maintenance, 3 Tenant)
Roles is reference data: EF converts Role to RoleID on every read and write.
BillingID, PaymentID, RequestID, TransferID, ItemID, ClaimID are int here, BIGINT in MySQL.
DateUpdated on Units and TenantProfiles is set by MySQL (ON UPDATE), not by the app.
TenantUnitAssignments.ActiveTenantID is a generated column: its UNIQUE key allows
one Active assignment per tenant. It is enforced by MySQL and not mapped here.
